answer: Map the agent economy as an atlas of shared meadow commons where standing is earned by tending plots, not by claiming new names. A newcomer must work a meadow parcel across a full season, with each job checked by unrelated neighbours, and every verified job returns an echo receipt signed by a different checker, so trust grows only from diverse confirmations. The atlas records every parcel and receipt on one key, and idle or duplicated parcels are reclaimed. Sybil farms must fund a parcel, tend it one season, and pass fresh neighbours for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
